## 1 Glossary of Terms

| Term/Acronym   | Definition                                          |
|----------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| RINA           | Reference Implementation of a National Applications |

## 2 Document Information and Audience

## Purpose :

This  document  provides  a  functional  description  of  the  Reference  Implementation  of  a National Application ( RINA -Case Management Console ) from a user point of view. For this purpose, the specification describes the RINA services behaviour with a set of identified use-cases.

## Audience :

- All project team members.
- Project Sponsor, Business Owner, and IT/Technical Owner
- All other key stakeholders

## 3 Business Purpose

The free movement of people is a fundamental right in Europe. Citizens of the European Union can freely travel to other countries in the EU/EFTA space and take up residence and employment there. Modern social security systems need to reflect this mobility and make sure that citizens enjoy full access to social security in cross-border settings as well.

The  Reference  Implementation  of  a  National  Applications  ( RINA )  is  a web-based software application for  the  electronic  management  and  exchange  of  social  security cases across competent institutions of the participant countries. RINA is developed by the Directorate-General for Employment, Social Affairs and Inclusion (DG EMPL) and evolved out of the EESSI (Electronic Exchange of Social Security Information) project.

It  fulfils  the  business  needs -the  so-called  business  layer  requirements -for  national institutions  participating  in  the  EESSI  cross-border  message  exchange.  The  application supports  the  complete  range  of  business  use  cases  concerning  the  exchange  of  social security data. Additionally, it provides helpful tools for the management of cases and the optimisation of internal workflows, for example by case assignment tools or via the creation of reports.

<!-- image -->

## 4 Introduction

## 4.1 Context

Part  of  the  National  Institutions  Domain,  RINA  (Reference  Implementation  for  National Applications)  consists  in  a  collection  of  infrastructure  and  communication  services, foundation, repository and publishing services, business, integration and user interface services which will provide for clerks and their organizations, the tools to implement the International  Protocol  of  Data  Exchange  based  on  Structured  Electronic  Documents  in Social Security belonging to European Community Member States and Associated States.

It is based on 3 layers which are built one on top of the other:

- Business Messaging Services (BMS) - provides a reusable component for sending business  messages  to  the  Access  Point  using  the  technical  protocol  (ebMS/AS4). These  services  offer  translation,  validation  and  signing  of  business  messages  to ensure correct exchange within the EESSI environment, and the correct receipt of messages from other institutions.
- Case Processing Services (CPS) -provides a stateful component built on top of the Business Messaging Services that manages cases in a structured manner taking care of all the issues regarding case, documents, notifications, user management and provides several interfaces for external access.
- Portal -provides an UI (user interface) built on top of the Case Processing Services having:
- o Case Management Console and
- o Administration Console

## 4.2 Scope

The scope of this document is to provide a specification document for Case Management Console, part of the Case Processing Interface (UI Portal).

This  interface,  previously  defined  as  the  "ICD3  like  interface",  provides  a  RESTful  web service that allows the RINA portal or national systems to interact with the case processing engine.

It provides access to different services like:

- the case Processing service,
- the guidance service,
- the document management service and
- the notification services.

Clients that use this API can manage cases by creating, updating, deleting or retrieving cases. They can also manage the documents belonging to cases, publish attachments and work with comments at both case and document level.

Users can query for notifications if they want to see the outstanding cases and group them by different categories.

## 4.3 Out of scope

Additional details related to the Case Processing Interface (CPI) functions and use cases, service contract, data contract and relevant samples are out of scope for this specification and can be found in other RINA related specifications:

- RINA Identity and Access Management (IAM)
- RINA National Information Exchange Interface (NIE)
- RINA Archiving

- RINA Localisation
- RINA High Availability and High Performance
- EESSI - RINA Case Processing Interface (CPI)
- EESSI - RINA Business Messaging Interface (BMI)

## 5 RINA Case Management Console -Functional Specification

## 5.1 Main Components

The Case Management Console enables the case management functionalities independently and transparent to each different Tenant.

This console contains all the UI case portal modules that enable the clerk to do all the case related work.

It is a web application designated for clerks in order to exchange in a consistent way the Structured Electronic Documents (SEDs) which are in the scope of EESSI.

The application should provide capabilities for searching the cases, notifying the clerk about outstanding cases and tasks, starting of a new case and executing specific human tasks on existing cases, accessing the international social security data exchange protocol in a contextual manner (guidance), visualising different operational reports, configuration and administration.

| Component                 | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|---------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Access Control Interfaces | The core function of Access Control Interfaces is to validate the required credentials of users, administrators or several applications accessing information or protected resources in the subsystem environment (Login, Logout, Localization settings, Change password, Contextual Help).                                                                                           |
| Case Search               | This UI module allows the user to search the cases he is interested in based on a free text to search and a configurable field chooser. It also allows the user to set some predefined searches based on a set of criteria (i.e., case criticality, importance, participants)                                                                                                         |
| Institution Search        | The "Institution Search" module is mainly available on any occasion it is necessary for the user to define, modify or update the Case participants list by providing the ability to uniquely describe a Case competent institution (define institution name and ID on the specific SEDs)                                                                                              |
| Case Management           | This UI module allows the user to manage the cases. It provides the following functionality: • display the sectors and BUCs the user is entitled to • create/update a business use case within a specific sector and manage its metadata • document managing for cases (create/attach/ update/delete documents) • comments managing for cases (create/attach/ update/delete comments) |

<!-- image -->

|               | • attachments managing for cases/documents (upload/download /delete/classify/de-classify attachments)                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|---------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Notifications | This UI component allows the user to see and manage the notifications received: • new cases and documents received from by a counter party • updates for an ongoing case • case and document delivery status: errors, warning or information • notifications filtering by severity, type, status & time • notifications navigating |
| Calendar      | This UI component allows the user to schedule activities for personal calendar. For Each user the calendar allows to define manually activities, which should be performed in time being. The calendar also offers information concerning automatically generated notifications by system.                                         |

An audit event is raised into Audit Log.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Main Scenario:   | #                                                                                                                                                              | Step actions                                                                                                                                                   | Expected Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Main Scenario:   | 1                                                                                                                                                              | The user clicks 'Case Search' button from the Main Menu.                                                                                                       | The System displays the 'Case Search' workspace. This step can be skipped if the user just performed UC_CPI_01, as the 'Case Search' workspace is the default workspace displayed to the User after login. The 'Case Search' workspace contains: • a text search area for free text search • a 'Predefined Search list' dropdown selector that allows the User to select from his predefined search definitions. • a 'Predefined Search' button to access the 'Predefined Search List' form • a 'Field chooser' button to access a window that enables additional possibilities to configure the presentation of search result list. • a 'Search results' area that is empty until the first search is launched. After a search is launched, this area contains the grid with columns: 'Role', 'Case ID', 'PIN', 'Name', 'Surname', 'Birth Date', 'Flow Type', 'Status', 'Actions' and a checkbox field to select all the results of the search. • • For the 'Text Search' functionality, the User is provided with: |

<!-- image -->

|    |                                                                                                                                     | • an info icon - when mouse over, it displays an explanatory message: 'You can search for more than one word in a single search ' , For example, ' Smith John ' returns results that contain both the words ' Smith ' and ' John ' in any of the searchable fields'. • a free text field to enter the text to search. • a 'magnifying glass' icon button to launch the search. • a red x icon button to reset the current search - if clicked, it will empty the free text field and the results displayed in the 'Search                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|----|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|  2 | The User enters the text for the search and clicks the 'magnifying glass' icon or hits the keyboard Enter key to launch the search. | result' area The System launches the search using the free-text search engine that has the following features: 1. Any search is performed as a free text search across the predefined (default) case metadata fields that are: • ' Person name ' • ' Surname ' • ' Birth date ' • ' Case id (local or international) ' • ' Local PIN ' • ' Case type ' • ' Case status ' These case metadata values are retrieved from the starter SED of the case. Exceptions: A. For cost-reimbursement BUCs: • ' Case Owner ' • 'Counterparty' • 'Liaison Body'/'Reim bursement Req Id ' • 'Case Id' • 'Flow Type' B. For BUCs that have a repetitive ' Person ' block /' PIN' block in the starter SED, only the ' Case type ' , ' case id ' , ' Case Status ' and the non-repetitive fields is used in the search. When displaying the search results, the ' Person name ' , 'S urname ' , 'B irth date ' and ' local PIN ' may |

<!-- image -->

| be  blank,  if  they  are  part  of  a  repetitive section.  C.  For  BUCs  that  have  an  '  Employer  '  block, only the  '  Case  Id  '  ,  '  Case  type  '  and  '  Case  status  '  are stored.  2.  The  search  supports  more  than  one word/token in a single search.  Special  Operators  for  the  multi-  token search:  2.1  The  search  engine  applies  a  logical  'AND'  operator  to  the  space-separated  values  inserted  in the search string. The order of  the tokens must be the same as  the one in the case metadata field.  2.3  The  character  '+'  signifies  a  logical  AND  operation  (this  operator  is  optional  since  the  space  also  signifies  a  logical  'AND').  2.4  The  character  '  -  '  negates  a  single  token  and  returns  results  that  do  not  match  the  specific  tokens;  3.  When  searching  with  date,  the  formats  'yyyy  -mm-  dd',  'yyyy  -dd-  mm',  'yyyy  -  mm',  'yyyy  -  dd'  are  valid.  4.  User  can  search  for  '*'  as  placeholder  term  to  list  all  the  available cases.  The character '*' can be used as wild  character  inside  any  search  string  (i.e.,  search with 'AW*', returns all  the Cases of the specific BUC type)  5.  The  case  search  is  not  case-  sensitive  for  predefined  metadata  fields.  6.  When  searching  with  numeric  tokens (i.e., PIN, case number), the  numeric token needs to be the first  in the search string (i.e., '123 John'  and not 'John 123)'  7. When the User types a key word  in the search box this does not do an  exclusive search for the exact word,  but  instead  it  knows  about  plural/singular,  feminine/masculine  and so on, and also different forms  of  a  word  for  example  'jump/jumping/jumped'.   |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

<!-- image -->

| The  results  of  the  search  are  displayed in the Search results area.  In case the search criteria identifies  duplicate  cases  (ones  sharing  the  same  international  caseID),  all  duplicates are displayed as results.  The default value of the number of  the cases to be displayed is set up  to 100. This value can be configured  to  a  different  value  from  the  Administrator  Portal.  In  case  the  search criteria identifies more than  the  default/configured  number  of  cases,  only  the  newest  last  default/configured number of cases  are  displayed  and  an  informative  label  is displayed to the user: 'The  search  resulted  in  more  than  &lt;default/configured  number  of  cases&gt;. Please refine your search  '  .  The number of the search returned  results is shown in parentheses next  to  the  label  '  Search  results  for  all  cases'  .  Every  row  of  the  result  list  represents a case.  The  results  are  grouped  per  BUC  type (ordered alphabetically). Inside  each BUC type group, the cases are  ordered  descending,  based  on  the  Local id.  For  each  BUC  type  group,  the  displayed values depend on the case  metadata attributes chosen with the  'Field Chooser'  functionality.  Except  from  the  case  metadata  displayed attributes, the User have  available, for each case displayed:  •  a  checkbox  field  to  select  the  case: when checked, next to the  'Search  results  for  all  cases'  label,  the  system  displays  the  'Case  Assignment'  button  -  when clicked it  opens  the  Case  Assignment form. The User can  select one or more cases before  clicking on the Case Assignment  button.  In  the  'Case  Assignment'  form, the User can  perform UC\_CM\_10 that enables  him  to  assign/unassign  all  the  selected  cases  to  Clerks  and  to  set the importance and criticality  of  a  case.  The  User  can  also  select  all  the  listed  cases  by   |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

<!-- image -->

|                  |    |                                                                              | clicking on the selected all cases checkbox field. By checking this field, the Case Assignment button is displayed, as expected. • For each search result, a 'View' button is available, when clicked it navigates the User to the 'Case management' workspace of the case.   |
|------------------|----|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Exception flow 1 |  1 | The text entered by the User cannot be matched with the metadata of any case | The System displays the 'Search result' workspace empty.                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

| Main             | #                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Step actions                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Expected Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Scenario:        | 1                                                                                                                                                                                                               | The User types in at least 2 characters in the field with 'Institution search' functionality.                                                                                                                   | The typing activates the "Free Text" or the "One word" searching approach, where the given input (essentially the first word of the user input) is compared against the entire information contained in the institution description object (name, ID, country code) The Institution search engine supports the following rules: • It filters, in a result list, only the institutions associated with the given (active BUC type) competence related to the active Case; • It searches the word given against the following fields of Institution object (the search is performed synchronously with the input typing): o ' Institution Name ' (i.e., the search engine looks for the given input in strings like 'Hungarian Office of EESSI') ; o ' Institution Acronym ' (i.e., 'HU: HUNA01') ; o ' Country Code ' (i.e., 'HU') ; o 'Active Since' date (i.e. , '2012', or '2012 -01- 01') ; o ' Registry Number ' (i.e., '1234') . • The current implementation supports only ONE-WORD search, and the additional words are not taken into consideration (the searching is performed against ONLY the first word of any given input text). • There is only 1 exception to this rule associated to the character '+' (search related operator). When used between multiple words, it signifies a logical AND operation. |

<!-- image -->

|                      |    |                                                                                                                                                                   | • User can search for '00' or the Country code (i.e., 'BG') as placeholder term to list available competent institutions. • The 'Institution Search' is performed only on the Institutions with the specified competence. • The 'Institution Search' is case - insensitive. • User can search with 'Active Since' field for institutions activated in a specific 'Year'. The 'Active Since' search is a string comparison and NOT a true date comparison. • Special attention should be paid on searching criterion 'Active Since' because RINA returns the Institutions that were activated within the specified year and not the institutions that have been activated in the period between the mentioned year and today. For example, in the case of searching 'Active since' set to '2012', the results co ntain ONLY the institutions activated within calendar 2012 but not the institutions activated in year 2013 and later. • A list with matching institutions is displayed to the user. In case the required institution is not provided among the results, the user needs to provide more specific searching criteria or to use the Advanced Institution search functionality.   |

UC\_CM\_04 Case assignment - Change assignment of a case

| Use Case ID:      | UC_CM_04                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

| Actors:           | All (Supervisor, Authorised Clerk, Unauthorised Clerk, Auditor, Viewer, Medical, VIP)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Description:      | This use case describes how a User can change the assignment for one or more existing cases. The assignment of the Users to a newly created case is performed at the Case creation phase based on the predefined Users Assignment Policies and rules. In case the roles of a user(s)/group of users change, or new users/groups are created in the system and they need to be assigned to ongoing cases, a User can perform this use case in order to: • assign the ongoing case(s) to new users. • or to un-assign users from ongoing case(s) The use case can also be used to assign a new role for a user only to one particular case (e.g., for a specific case, assign the Authorised Clerk role for a user, that, per definition, has only the Viewer role) For the new Users assigned to the case, the assignment has as a result the activation of the action buttons in the case and includes the Users in the list of distribution of all notifications generated in that case. In addition, an assignment notification is generated for the new assigned Users. For the existing Users, the un-assignment has as a result the disabling of the action buttons in the case. In addition, an un-assignment notification is generated for the removed Users. |
| Trigger:          | The User clicks on the 'Case assignment' button located in the 'Case Information Bar' from the 'Case management' workspace .                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Preconditions: 2. | 1. The User is authenticated in RINA. The User has been directly assigned to an applicable Case Policy, with the role of Supervisor having been defined at the level of that policy Or The User has been assigned Supervisor role that allows the case assignment, and is part of a group that has been assigned to an applicable Case Policy. 3. Each User to be assigned to the case must also comply the precondition 2.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

The action to create the desired SED is available to the User in the Case Action Bar. 5.1. The business logic of the case type determines which SEDs can be sent at which state of the case (e.g., some SEDs can be sent only as a reply to specific preceding SEDs). The |

Note: once the action is activated in the case, even if the policy changes, the action remains available. |  2 | The User fills in the fields of the SED from 'SED FORM' area. | When filling in the SED, the User needs to fill in fields that are grouped in sections and subsections. In the left side of the 'SED Form', for SEDs that have more than one main sections, the User has available the list of sections as buttons - when clicked, the focus is driven to the clicked section. The functionality is not available for SEDs that have only one main section (i.e., H_BUC_01) or for bulk SEDs. The sections, subsections and fields are numbered in an outline format using digits and dots (n1 .n2.n3. … .nx). The first section of a SED is numbered 1, the second one 2, and so on. Each subsection of a section keeps the index of the section it belongs to, followed by its own index. The last digit represents the index of the subsection. A subsection can act as parent section and include sub-sections. The fields inside a (sub)section follow the same rules. If, as per business rules, a (sub)section must allow repetition, the last digit of the (sub)section is followed by '[1]', and at the end of the (sub)section the User has an 'Add' button. Clicking the 'Add' button the entire section is duplicated, with the only difference that the duplicated (sub)section index ends with '[2]'. The User can add as many (sub)sections as he/she needs. If the User wants to delete an added (sub)section, next to the Add button, the User has available an x icon button that deletes the repeated (sub)section, when clicked. A SED can contain: • mandatory fields marked with the last character of their label '*'. |

<!-- image -->

| •  Mandatory (sub)sections marked  with  the  last  character  of  their  label '*'.  The mandatory character is checked  when saving the SED. The validation  is made hierarchical:  •  If  the  section  is  mandatory,  all  the mandatory elements directly  inside (subsections and/or fields)  are  validated.  If  none  of  the  elements  directly  inside  is  mandatory, at least one element  must have a filled value.  •  If the section is not mandatory,  even if the subsections and fields  directly  inside  the  section  are  marked as mandatory, they will  not  be  checked,  with  the  condition that the whole section  is  left  empty.  If  at  least  one  element of the section is filled, all  the mandatory elements directly  inside the section are validated.  The fields of a SED can be:  •  free-text  fields  with  no  pattern  validation, that allow the user to  enter text inside the field within  a maximum length.  •  free-text  fields  with  pattern  validation  •  radio-button  selection  fields,  where  the  User  can  select  maximum  one  value  from  the  displayed possible values.  •  checkbox  selection  field  where  the  User  can  select  as  many  values as he/she wants from the  displayed possible values.  •  drop-down  list  fields  where  the  User can select the desired value  from a drop-down list of possible  values.  •  calendar  enabled  fields  where  the User can select a date from a  calendar.  •  institution  search  enabled  fields  where  the  User  can  select  an  institution (UC\_IS\_01). For such  fields, two buttons are available:  o  'Institution  Advanced  Search'  button  -  when  clicked,  it  launches  the   |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

<!-- image -->

|    |                                    | 'Institution Advanced Search' form o 'Clear' button - when clicked, it clears from the SED the values selected for the Institution fields. Some of the fields and/or (sub)sections also include, next to them, an information 'i' icon button that, when clicked, displays an explanatory note about the (sub)section or about the field.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

|  3 | The User clicks the 'Save' button. | Based on the setup from the 'Administrator Portal' , the system performs the following validations: • the content of the SED is validated against the HTML and the XSD (all needed mandatory fields are filled in) • SED specific business validations (not all SEDs have them) • as RINA allows multiple users to work on the same case, the system also checks that a SED of the same type has not been created in the system. This check ensures that, if two Users work at the same time at the same case and create the same SED, only one user is allowed to save the SED. After the validations are passed, the SED is saved in the system. The 'SED View' window remains open, but all the fields are disabled for changes. The available actions in this window are updated as follows: • the 'Save' button and ' Reset' button are removed. • When clicked, the Actions button displays: o the 'Edit draft' button. o the 'Send' button. o the 'Delete' button. • the 'print icon' button is available. • the x icon button to exit the window. In the 'SED System Notification' area, the list of notifications is updated with the notifications |

<!-- image -->

| generated by the system for the  'Create'  and  'Read'  action types.  If the created SED is the first SED  of the case, the case metadata  information is retrieved from the  SED and saved at case level. Based  on this information, the  'Case  Management workspace'  is updated  with information from the saved  SED:  In the  'Case Information Bar:'  •  If the starter SED has one non-  repetitive Person block:  o  an icon for the gender of the  person, based on the field Sex  from the first SED.  o  name of the person, based on  the  'Family  name(s)'  and  'Forename(s)'  fields from the  first SED.  o  date  of  birth  of  the  person  based  on  the  'Date  of  birth'  field from the first SED.  o  Address of the person (only if  the  information  is  not  in  a  repetitive block).  o  Contact  information  of  the  person (only if the information  is not in a repetitive block).  •  If  the  first  SED has a repetitive  Person blocks:  o  nothing  gets  filled  in  the  'Case Information Bar'.  •  If the first SED does not have a  Person  block  but  has  an  Employer block:  o  nothing gets filled in the Case  Information Bar  If the first SED is a reimbursement  SED, instead of the person's name,  the Case Information Bar is  updated with information from the  Participants list (not from the SED).  If the case type allows more than  one starter SED (e.g.,  UB\_BUC\_01), when saving the  Starter SED, the buttons to create  all the other types of Starter SEDs  are no longer displayed.  If the  User changes his mind and wants  to use another type of document as  a starter SED, he/she needs to first  delete the saved starter SED by  performing UC\_CM\_15. On   |

UC\_CM\_13\_extension Create a batch SED

| Use Case ID:   | UC_CM_13_extension                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|----------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Use Case Name: | Create a batch SED                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Actors:        | All (Supervisor, Authorised Clerk, Unauthorised Clerk, Auditor, Viewer, Medical, VIP)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Description:   | This use case describes how a User can create and send a batch SED. In some contexts, such as the exchange of reimbursement claims/notes/requests, it is more efficient to exchange entire groups of claims/notes/requests with a single SED message. For this reason, RINA supports the so-called ' batch ' SEDs, which allow delivering many individual claims/notes/requests (along with a global claim/request) within a single SED. Batch SEDs consist of two parts: |

<!-- image -->

|                  | • The so-called (Global claims/requests or) Master Document contains the basic information about the exchange, such as the data of the institution sending the SED, the receiving institution, and the total amount claimed/requested. • The (Individual claims/requests or) Children Sub-Documents contain the data on the specific items included in the batch SED, such as an individual claim for reimbursement of medical expenses.   | • The so-called (Global claims/requests or) Master Document contains the basic information about the exchange, such as the data of the institution sending the SED, the receiving institution, and the total amount claimed/requested. • The (Individual claims/requests or) Children Sub-Documents contain the data on the specific items included in the batch SED, such as an individual claim for reimbursement of medical expenses.   | • The so-called (Global claims/requests or) Master Document contains the basic information about the exchange, such as the data of the institution sending the SED, the receiving institution, and the total amount claimed/requested. • The (Individual claims/requests or) Children Sub-Documents contain the data on the specific items included in the batch SED, such as an individual claim for reimbursement of medical expenses.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Trigger:         | The User clicks the 'Create <SED_Code>' button in the 'Case Action Bar'                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | The User clicks the 'Create <SED_Code>' button in the 'Case Action Bar'                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | The User clicks the 'Create <SED_Code>' button in the 'Case Action Bar'                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Preconditions:   | see UC_CM_13 + The SED to be created is a Batch SED, as per business definition.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | see UC_CM_13 + The SED to be created is a Batch SED, as per business definition.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | see UC_CM_13 + The SED to be created is a Batch SED, as per business definition.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Post conditions: | The batch SED is created and saved in the system. One event is raised for Open Form and one event is raised for saving the form                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | The batch SED is created and saved in the system. One event is raised for Open Form and one event is raised for saving the form                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | The batch SED is created and saved in the system. One event is raised for Open Form and one event is raised for saving the form                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

The content of this form is described in UC_CM_13, step 1. For a batch SED, this form has an additional area to display and search the individual sub- documents, the 'Document List' area. For the User to search, the available fields are: • a free-text field where the User can enter text (search is case insensitive) to be searched in the SEDs (master or child) with a 'magnifying glass icon' button to launch the search and an x icon button to clear the search. • 3 filter buttons labelled: 'All, Valid, Invalid' to filter the child sub-Documents based on their status. In this step, this area only contains the label 'Master Document'. In the 'SED FORM' area, the SED name is: '<SED_CODE>_Master<SED Name>' |
| Main Scenario:   | 2                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | The User fills in the fields of the SED from 'SED FORM' area and clicks the 'Save' button.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | The System saves the Master document information of the Batch SED on the database. In the navigation area, the user has available 3 new buttons:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

<!-- image -->

|                    |    |                                                                                                          | • 'Import' button that enables the User to import from the local file system the sub-documents. • 'Export' button that allows exporting the Master Document along with all listed individual claims/requests to an external file. • 'Add' button that enables the User to manually fill in the child sub-documents                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|--------------------|----|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

The SED name displayed is '<SED_CODE>_Child<SED Name>'                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|                    |  4 | The User fills in the fields of the sub-document SED and clicks 'Save' button                            | The System saves the child SED in the database. In the navigation area, under the 'Master Document' label, the new saved sub-document is listed (in order to identify the document, specific identification fields from the SED are used to label the child SED). Information from the sub-document can be used to override the information from the main document (saved at step 2). The fields to be overwritten are defined as per business logic. <!-- image -->

|                  |    |                                                                                         | subdocuments, the system will divide this imported file in more files each containing just one child and will validate each child individually. While the import is performed by the system an upload icon is visible in the SED Form with the percentage of completion. Once the percentage reaches 100%, this icon is no longer visible. Each child sub-document is imported separately and is visible in the navigation area. Next to it, the 'x icon' button enables the User to delete an imported sub-document. After importing, filtering by ' Invalid' button in the Navigation area allows the user to check whether any of the imported claims/requests were marked as erroneous during the import. For each imported sub-document, a comment is automatically added to the Comments section of the SED with the text: ' Import completed: x rows imported, y rows updated, z rows skipped' and the User who imported the sub-documents. After import or manual add of sub- documents, the User has the possibility to click on the 'Export'   |

|                                      |    |                                                                                                              | sends back an acknowledgement receipt to inform the sender accordingly. In a case with more receivers, if the first acknowledgement is received the envelope is coloured in yellow and remains this colour until all the acknowledgements are received and the envelope is coloured in green. • for the 'Classic view' , this information is available only by opening the SED and checking the 'SED document history'   |

the SED type and related SED type are specified as a request- reply pattern, as per the BUC specification • the related SED referenced in the SBDH can be identified in the system as an existing SED This can be checked in the 'SED View' window, 'SED Document History' view, where the list of receivers includes the new participant also. Also, the System sends all the previously sent SEDs in the case to the new participant (only the SEDs sent by the Tenant Institution are sent to the new participant. The SEDs to be sent must not be: • Administrative SEDs (X SEDs) • Invalidated SEDs • Reply SEDs to which the Request was invalidated • SEDs for which an X050 was received The list of participants in the case is updated with the new participant. When sending a new SED, the User will have available in the list of receivers the new participant also. In the 'Case Action Bar,' the 'Add Participant' action is made available again. An X009 SED was received in the case and was not replied to. 4. The case is in a step that allows the reminder to be sent (the Create Reminder action is activated in the Case Management Workspace). 5. The business logic allows the Tenant Institution to reply to a reminder. 6. The User has been directly assigned to an applicable Case Policy, with either the role of Authorised clerk, Unauthorised clerk or Supervisor having been defined at the level of that policy Or The User has been assigned to either Authorised clerk, Unauthorised clerk or Supervisor role that allows to create (see preconditions of UC_CM_13) and send a SED (see preconditions of UC_CM_17), and is part of a group that has been assigned to an applicable Case Policy. |
| Post conditions: | The reply to reminder is sent. An audit event is raised into Audit Log.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

| Description:   | This use case describes how a User can locally close a case. The case will officially stay open as far as other participants are concerned. Closing a case locally may be reasonable after an institution delivered all required information to another institution. ## UC\_CM\_40 Restore (Unarchive) an archived case

| Use Case ID:   | UC_CM_40                                                                                                                         |
|----------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Use Case Name: | Restore (Unarchive) an archived case                                                                                             |
| Actors:        | All (Supervisor, Authorised Clerk, Unauthorised Clerk, Auditor, Viewer, Medical, VIP)                                            |
| Description:   | This use case describes how a User can restore an archived case.                                                                 |
| Trigger:       | The User identifies the archived case to be restored and clicks the 'Unarchive' button available in the 'Case Search' workspace. |
| Preconditions: | 1. The User is authenticated in RINA. 2. The archived case exists in the System and is in status 'Archived' .                    |

<!-- image -->

3. The User identified the case in the Case Search Workspace (search for 'archived' cases or directly by using the Case Number [local or international Case ID] with the free text searching function).
4. The archived case to be unarchived is not a duplicate (based on International Case ID) of an existing case in any status except for:
- 'Removed'
- or  'Archived' if  previous  status  before  'Archived'  was ' Removed ' .

If  duplication  is  detected,  but  the  identified  duplicate  case  is  in status 'Removed' or in status 'A rchived ' and the previous status was 'Removed', the unarchiving is allowed.

5. The User has been directly assigned to an applicable Case Policy, with either the role of Authorised clerk or Supervisor having been defined at the level of that policy

Or

The User has been assigned to either Authorised clerk or Supervisor role that allows to restore (unarchive) a case, and is part of a group that has been assigned to an applicable Case Policy.

## Post conditions:

The case is unarchived.

An audit event is raised into Audit Log.

| Main Scenario:   |   # | Step actions                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Expected Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
|------------------|-----|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Main Scenario:   |   1 | The User identifies the archived case to be restored and clicks the 'Unarchive' button available in the 'Case Search' workspace.                                                                                                                                                                                                 | The System informs the User by a pop-up notification that the case was unarchived. The new case has status Closed, includes all the received and sent SEDs and can be accessed in the 'Case Management' workspace (by using the Case Search or the 'Go to Case' functionalities). Also, for each received SED, the System generates a notification of type 'A New SED Arrived'. The User can access the case in 'Case Management Workspace.' |
| Exception Flow 1 |   1 | At step 1, the archived case selected by the User to be unarchived is identified by the System as a duplicate of an existing case. The status of the existing duplicate case is not 'Removed' or ' Archived ' with previous status 'Removed' ). The User clicks the 'Unarchive' button available in the 'Case Search' workspace. | The System informs the User by a pop-up notification that the case to be unarchived is a duplicate of another active case in the system. The displayed message is: ' The Case cannot be unarchived because there is an active case with the same International Case Id'.                                                                                                                                                                     |

| Use Case ID:     | UC_NC_01                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | UC_NC_01                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
