| Actors:          | All (Supervisor, Authorised Clerk, Unauthorised Clerk, Auditor, Viewer, Medical, VIP)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | All (Supervisor, Authorised Clerk, Unauthorised Clerk, Auditor, Viewer, Medical, VIP)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Description:     | This use case describes how a User can access and navigate the Notifications.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | This use case describes how a User can access and navigate the Notifications.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Trigger:         | The User clicks ' Notifications ' button from Main Menu.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | The User clicks ' Notifications ' button from Main Menu.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Preconditions:   | 1. The User is authenticated in RINA. 2. The User is authorized to see the notifications for the cases. New notifications for cases not assigned to the User performing the use case are not displayed in the Notifications. New notifications for cases marked as Sensitive with a ' VIP flag ' set on ' YES ' are only visible to users with ' VIP flag". For ongoing cases, any changes in the policies of the User and/or in the sensitivity flag of the cases from ' NO ' to ' YES ' causes the following changes: • the list of existing displayed notifications is not changed, the only impact is in the possible actions to be perform on those notification (like Open case, Assign, etc) that are updated accordingly to new situation. • the new notifications are not displayed to the user | 1. The User is authenticated in RINA. 2. The User is authorized to see the notifications for the cases. New notifications for cases not assigned to the User performing the use case are not displayed in the Notifications. New notifications for cases marked as Sensitive with a ' VIP flag ' set on ' YES ' are only visible to users with ' VIP flag". For ongoing cases, any changes in the policies of the User and/or in the sensitivity flag of the cases from ' NO ' to ' YES ' causes the following changes: • the list of existing displayed notifications is not changed, the only impact is in the possible actions to be perform on those notification (like Open case, Assign, etc) that are updated accordingly to new situation. • the new notifications are not displayed to the user |
| Post conditions: | The User has access to all the business notifications. An audit event is raised into Audit Log.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | The User has access to all the business notifications. An audit event is raised into Audit Log.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Main Scenario:   | #                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Expected Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

5.2.5.1.1

Use case diagrams

<!-- image -->

| 1   | The User clicks the button 'Notifications' from the Main Menu. The label of this button also contains the number of notifications. This is a dynamic label and will be updated according to the number of notifications in the system.   | The System displays the 'Notifications Workspace' area . In this window, the User sees all the notifications related to the cases the User has created or has been assigned to. These notifications are generated by the System, based on four main triggers: • A case workflow action has been executed by a case participant; • A request to assign a case to a certain User arrived, has been accepted or rejected; • An error occurred; • An internal alarm has expired; The Notification workspace has 2 areas: 1. The Display area The notifications are displayed in a grid with the following header: • Checkbox field - when selected all displayed notifications are selected. For each displayed notification, the checkbox field is also available. Clicking on the checkbox field at notification level/ all notification level) activates 2 buttons in the header: o a button labelled 'Mark as Unread' o a button labelled 'Mark as Read' • (show details column)- for each displayed notification, in this column the User has available the'>' button for displaying the details of the notification • (more info column) - for each displayed notification, in this column the User has available two icons: o An info ' ! ' icon- to indicate the type of notification coloured in blue for information notification, yellow for warning notification and red for error notification o The criticality and severity matrix icon of the case • 'Date' - the date when notification was generated • 'Type' - type of notification • 'Description • Actions' - for each displayed   |
|-----|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

<!-- image -->

UC\_NC\_17 Notification of type 'SED Update without Create'

| Use Case ID:   | UC_NC_17                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|----------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Use Case Name: | Notification of type 'SED Update without Create'                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Actors:        | All (Supervisor, Authorised Clerk, Unauthorised Clerk, Auditor, Viewer, Medical, VIP)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Description:   | This use case describes how a User is notified about the fact that a SED received in the system represents an update for a SED that does not exist in the system. When receiving a SED with case action 'Update' , the system will check that the version of the document to be updated (Related SetId) referenced in the received SED corresponds to a SED existing in the system. If it does not exist, this new received SED will be kept in a queue for a 24hour waiting period. After this period, if the check is still not passed, the system: • removes the SED from the waiting queue. • automatically generates a business exception X050 SED and sends it to the sender of the SED • automatically generates a notification for the users of the system |

| Description:     | This use case describes how a User is notified about the fact that a received SED is a duplicate of an existing SED. The verification for duplicate: • For a received SED with case action 'START'/ 'STARTFORWARD', the System checks if the received SED references an International CaseID already existing in the system (a duplicate case). • For a received SED with case action 'NEW'/ 'NEWFORWARD', the System checks if the contained SED already exists. • The received SED references an International CaseID existing in the system in any status, except from: o status 'Removed' or o status 'Archived' that follows a 'Removed' status. The exception ensures that a removed participant from the case (via a Forward or Remove) can be later re-added in the case, if needed. This message is not included in the existing case. |
| Trigger:         | A new SED is received. The User identifies the received notification of type 'A duplicate message arrived' and clicks on the expand notification button, represented with the '>' icon, in the 'Notifications' workspace.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Preconditions:   | 1. The User is authenticated in RINA. 2. The User is assigned to the International CaseID referenced in the received SED, prior to its reception. 3. The notification of type 'A duplicate message arrived' is configured from the Administrator Console to be available to the clerk. 4. A new SED is received and the system identifies the message as a duplicate of an existing message (while all other checks, i.e., 'case missing', 'case forwarded', 'case removed', 'case closed', 'SED in wrong sequence', 'SED Update without C reate', 'Attachments failed antimalware checks', ' Invalid business Signature ' are                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Post conditions: | The User is informed about the fact that a received SED identifies a duplicate case.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Main Scenario:   | # Step actions Expected Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

The System displays the details of the notification: 'Local Case Id', the Local Id of the existing case automatically created by the system. | 1.1.1   | Title*                 | Free-text field                   | Mandatory                                                                                                                                                             |
| 1.1.2   | Date*                  | Date field with calendar selector | Mandatory                                                                                                                                                             |
| 1.1.3   | Message                | Free-text field                   |                                                                                                                                                                       |
| 1.1.4   | Case ID*               | Free-text field                   | Mandatory. Accepts only numerical values The entered value is checked against the list of cases stored in the system and must match the local ID of an existing case. |
| 1.1.5   | Colour                 | Drop-down list                    | Default: no value selected                                                                                                                                            |
| 1.1.6   | Repetition             | Checkbox field                    | Default not selected                                                                                                                                                  |
| 1.1.7   | Every (days)           | Drop-down list                    | Enabled if Repetition field is checked. Possible values: from 1 to 31                                                                                                 |
| 1.1.8   | Occurrences            | Drop-down list                    | Enabled if Repetition field is checked. Default value: 1                                                                                                              |
| 1.1.9   | Reset                  | Button                            |                                                                                                                                                                       |
| 1.1.1 0 | Save                   | Button                            | Enabled when creating or editing a notification                                                                                                                       |
| 1.1.1 1 | Back                   | Button                            | When clicked, navigates back to the Calendar workspace                                                                                                                |
| 2       | Calendar               | Area                              |                                                                                                                                                                       |
| 2.1     | (Activity identifier)  | Button                            | One for each activity present in the calendar.                                                                                                                        |

<!-- image -->

|    |          |        | When clicked, displays the Calendar Activity Form                        |
|----|----------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|  3 | Previous | Button | When clicked, it displays in the Calendar area the previous month        |
|  4 | Next     | Button | When clicked, displays in the Calendar area the next month               |
|  5 | Today    | Button | When clicked, it displays in the Calendar area the current date in focus |
|  6 | Refresh  | Button | When clicked, the system will refresh the page                           |
